Camp Champions specializes in one- to four-week sessions where they create a loving environment and encourage every camper to discover the best versions of themselves while having a blast!

name: Camp Doublecreek

All day long every activity points them back to the Bible story. This is done through small groups, worship, snacks, art, STEM, drama, and music.

All sessions are different and unique – join for multiple sessions!

Camp Switch Willo offers a safe, confidence-building environment where kids learn new skills, make friends, and have an unforgettable camp experience. Hours are 9am-4pm.

name: Camp Vamonos!

Campers go on daily outings, including to the pool, as well as bake, create art and unique crafts, and enjoy timeless and low-tech toys and games. Kids feed their brains and their souls in a mixed-age, cozy setting. Se habla español también. Come play with us! Vamonos!

name: Ceramigos Kids Clay Club

Campers learn beginner-friendly handbuilding (pinch, coil, slab), try kid-safe wheel time (supervised and fun!), make creative projects like cups, creatures, bowls, and mini sculptures, and more.

name: Club SciKidz

These camps offer an unparalleled experience, fostering a love for STEM that lasts far beyond the summer.

locations.address: 1320 Arrow Point Dr, Cedar Park, TX 78613

Dripping Springs Ranch Park is the ideal Texas Hill Country setting for an amazing day camp.

name: Crayola Imagine Arts Academy

With five amazing camp themes, there’s something for every child. Register now, pay later!

locations.address: Multiple locations across Austin and San Antonio

Students master the art of mixing techno, progressive, trance, and house music using professional equipment provided, while learning directly from international DJ Victor Dinaire. The weekly camp concludes with a live performance opportunity at the fashion show every Friday, hosted at the Austin School of Fashion Studio.

name: Dragon's Lair Comic & Fantasy

Dragon's Lair hosts 10 different hobby camps, including Dungeons & Dragons, Pokémon, How to Make Comics, Daggerheart, Magic the Gathering, and Heroscape – each camp is a true celebration of creativity and hobbies. They offer a space to learn new games, make new friends, and experience what makes games fun!

name: Earth Native Wilderness School: Day Camps
description: Earth Native’s day camps get kids outdoors exploring, adventuring, and learning real nature skills. From hands-on discovery in Nature Quest Camp, wilderness confidence in Bushcraft Survival Camp, playful exploration in Forest Explorers Camp, rugged outdoor fun at Mission Wild Camp, to animal care and forest play at Camp Farm and Forest, every camp sparks curiosity, confidence, and connection to the natural world.

name: Earth Native Wilderness School: Overnight Camps
description: Adventure awaits at Earth Native’s Wilderness Overnight Camps! Campers spend Monday-Friday at the Bastrop campus learning hands-on wilderness skills with kids in their age group – from fire-making, shelter building, and natural navigation to tracking, wild edibles, tool safety, archery & paintball target practice. With expert guidance, meals, tents under the stars, and confidence-building challenges, these immersive overnight experiences spark independence, resilience, and a deep connection to nature.

name: Eastside Silver Prints Summer Photography Camp
description: A summer photography camp for ages 11-16 offering hands-on darkroom and photography instruction. Campers learn film photography, darkroom techniques, and creative expression through the art of silver gelatin printing.

name: Echo Hill Ranch Gold Star Camp

Campers make friends and enjoy horseback riding, swimming in the camp river, athletics, nature activities, and the creative arts. Children have the opportunity to have fun, relax, and be themselves in a supportive and positive setting.

name: EP Sports Academy

With intentionally low ratios and experienced coaches, campers get guidance, encouragement, and challenges each day of camp. Soccer Camp is designed for players who want to grow their skills. Through small group coaching and intentional drills, it blends technical training, tactical understanding, and physical development to help players build their soccer IQ.

Low-pressure and supportive, these camps balance comedic collaboration and skill-building with adventures in the absurd, inside jokes and new friends.

name: Fantastic Magic Camp
description: Austin’s most magical camp since 1993 – making memories and teaching life skills and confidence through magic, juggling, puppets, and fun! A fully inclusive day camp offers summer, spring, winter, and other holiday camps and events, as well as afterschool classes. Each day ends with a show by a magician, juggler, clown, puppeteer, ventriloquist, or storyteller – but most often a Magician! Register now before we are filled up…

name: Figment Creative Labs

The camp concludes with a final screening of the students’ completed projects, which are shared privately online with families once the camp ends.

If your camper is ready to live on the wild side, YMCA Camp Moody is the perfect place! Weekly themes are focused on outdoor activities: archery, atalatl, and beyond.

Because the final projects are actually built by them, students leave Game Worlds with both a game they feel proud of and the skills needed to build their next one!

With 12 fun themes like robots, rockets, Spy Academy, Yuckology, chemistry, and more, there’s something for every child. Register now, pay later!

Guided by expert educators, children build self-confidence and lasting friendships without the pressure of grades. Join us for a summer of intellectual freedom and nature-based discovery!

Daily Wellderness time builds mindfulness, balance, and a healthy mind and body across 3 acres of outdoor, tree-filled spaces with playgrounds and wildflower meadows.

And they do it right at home, in their own neighborhood, in real time! In just one week, your camper will turn a big idea into a real business, make a plan that wows everyone, meet with entrepreneur mentors, and become a confident business speaker.

Please contact Melinda Armbruster at or Tammy Kraus at for more information.

Each new challenge keeps engagement high while giving children repeated opportunities to build perseverance, problem-solving skills, and confidence. This program helps kids understand that abilities grow through effective strategies, effort, and feedback – empowering them to take on bigger challenges, stick with them longer, and unlock their full potential.

Playmore, and Top Golf. Camp Xtreme includes field trips like Typhoon Texas, Kalahari, and Austin's Park.

Performances happen on the Saturday following the final day of camp.

Tuition assistance is available to families experiencing hardship, and discounts are available to Sustaining pARTners.

There are a variety of water activities, including wakeboarding, slides, rope swings, blob, paddleboards, and aqua park.

name: Radiant G Camp

Weeklong day camps strengthen self efficacy – a girl’s belief in her ability to succeed through fun, connection, and skill building. They will also have fun horse games and arts & crafts inspired by horses and nature! Sign up online.

Campers are assigned their own horse for the week, and grouped based on their prior experience. Many riders attending are involved in year-round riding lessons at the farm or other Austin area barns along with those with little to no experience.

description: Looking for a way to get your kids outside, active, and engaged this summer or spring break? Kids Rock Climbing Camp is the perfect opportunity for children to experience the excitement of outdoor climbing in a fun, safe, and supportive environment. Designed to help kids build confidence, teamwork, and problem-solving skills, this camp provides a week full of adventure at some of the best climbing locations in Texas.

name: Sail Strong Sailing Camp
description: offers underserved youth the opportunity to build self-confidence, problem-solving skills, critical thinking, and teamwork through sailing. Campers are selected through an online application process. Criteria is visible on the website, as well as contact through .

name: Shirley McPhail School of Dance Camp
description: Each fun-filled week will explore a different theme with training in dance, tumbling, singing, creative movement, musical theatre, arts & crafts, and more. This is a great opportunity for students to experience a wide range of activities in the performing arts and help develop skills of creativity. At the end of each camp on Friday students will celebrate with a special performance for family and friends! No previous dance experience required.

name: Sitter Academy by Babysitting Connection
description: is a two-day, hands-on training designed to prepare babysitters with the skills, confidence, and professionalism parents trust. Participants learn child development, behavior management, digital and home safety, meal prep, and special-situation care, while earning CPR and First Aid certification. The program includes real-life, supervised infant care – diapers, bottles, bathing, and daily routines – along with practical training on running a babysitting biz!

name: Slumber Falls Camp
description: strives to create a welcoming camp community and invites families of all kinds to experience the joy of camp and the beauty of nature. New adventures await as campers experience the wonder of nature through outdoor activities such as fishing, hiking, archery, swimming, arts & crafts, and more. Campers can explore God’s amazing creation while strengthening independence, forming new friendships, learning new skills, and most importantly, having fun!

name: SoLa CrossFit Kids Camp
description: Action-packed fun for all fitness levels! This camp combines fun with functional movements to help young athletes develop strength, confidence, coordination, teamwork and lifelong healthy habits.

name: Spark Learning
description: Giving back to the local Austin autism community is at the heart of Spark Learning. They offer a fun, inclusive summer experience for kids and teens, thoughtfully grouped by age, development, and play style to support positive peer connections. Campers participate with or without ABA support in a safe, supportive environment focused on confidence, friendship, and summer fun. Families can choose embedded ABA support or a tuition-based camp option, with all participants enjoying shared activities, experiences, and memories together.

name: spilled milk social club
description: is the perfect camp for families who want traditional summer activities (field trips, arts & crafts, water play, etc.) mixed with “specialty” activities and projects (cooking, musical theatre, creative/athletic competition) at an affordable cost, and with flexible hours. They have a little something for everyone, and as long as your kid is up for trying new things, this is a great program that caters to many interests. Come join in on the fun!

name: Squad STX Boys Camp
description: is a 100% outdoor, all-boys summer camp run by military veterans and Aggie cadets, offering primitive camping, orienteering, and laser tag missions for boys seeking a fun challenge! Father & son sessions also available.

name: St. Andrew's School Summer Camp
description: Grab a friend and spend part of your summer days at a fun-filled day camp at St. Andrew's 31st Street or Southwest Parkway campus. The camp features classes in athletics, arts, academics, STEAM, and more, welcoming both the St. Andrew’s community and students from the greater Austin area and beyond.

name: Steve & Kate's Camp
description: Since 1980, Steve & Kate’s Camp has put kids in charge. Campers choose from a variety of activities in real time, including sewing, stop-motion, coding, sports & recreation, maker crafts, and more. And there’s plenty of perks for grownups too. Families can attend for a day, the entire summer, or anything in between. There’s no weekly sessions or reservations required. Any unused passes are automatically refunded at summer’s end. Lunch, snacks, and all hours (8am-6pm) included. .

name: Summer 2026 Dance Camps
description: offer dancers of all ages a fun and engaging way to stay active and inspired. Camps blend quality dance instruction with creative themes, movement games, and skill-building activities. Dancers explore styles such as ballet, hip-hop, jazz, contemporary, tap, acro, and more! All camps are led by experienced instructors and are designed to build confidence, coordination, and a love of dance in a supportive environment.

name: Summer History Explorers Camp
description: Young explorers are invited to step behind the scenes of Williamson County’s Media Through the Ages. Through hands-on activities and behind-the-lens experiments, campers will discover how newspapers, radio pioneers, early TV studios, and textile-based communication shaped our community’s stories. From creating film scripts and bold headlines to experimenting with printed fabrics and pattern-based storytelling, participants will explore the many ways people have shared information over time. This dynamic camp offers curious kids a fun, interactive path into media history and communication. .

locations.address: The Williamson Museum, 716 South Austin Ave., Georgetown

name: Synergy Dance Studio
description: offers exciting weekly themed dance camps for children at its Westlake studio. Preschool camps (9am-noon) and school-age camps (10am-3pm) include dancing plus fun art & crafts, with early drop-off and late pickup available. Themes include K-Pop, Princess Party, Unicorns & Mermaids, Labubu Boogie, Swiftie Summer, and Pop Stars. For dancers looking for more focused training, they offer jazz, ballet, contemporary, drill team, and musical theatre intensives divided into beginner to advanced levels.

name: TexArts
description: Step into enchanting worlds at weeklong musical theatre camps! Young performers will bring magical stories to life, singing and dancing to favorite songs from movies or TV shows. With a mix of creativity, teamwork, and fun, these themed camps will give your child summer friends and memories to remember. Or sign up for the two-week TexARTS Summer Musical: School of Rock! Turn up the volume in this fully produced performance camp where campers build rock-star skills through singing, acting, and high-energy choreography while working as an ensemble to bring this electrifying show to life. y.

name: Texas Climbing Adventures
description: Grab a spot for your kids in this fun outdoor rock climbing camp taking place at Reimers Ranch. Campers get professional instruction from SPI AMGA certified climbing instructors. The five-day camp will include rock-climbing techniques, introduction to equipment, and safety fundamentals. They focus on an appreciation of nature and teach using the challenge-by-choice method, encouraging participation and focus on each climber's growth and mental & skill development.

name: The Art Garage
description: Campers can look forward to creating 2-3+ art projects every day they are in camp. Thoughtfully curated curricula introduce a variety of art techniques, mediums, and art history, and projects are presented in an engaging and fun way. Your camper may work with canvas painting, hand-building with clay, glass fusion, sketching, collage, tie-dye, pottery painting, mosaic making, and more!

name: UMLAUF Summer Art Camp
description: This is a one-of-a-kind experience designed to spark imagination and curiosity. Campers will explore the beauty of art and nature through hands-on activities, outdoor adventures, and engaging projects inspired by the Sculpture Garden.

name: Wet & Wild Adventure Camp
description: is a unique day camp where kids go on a different field trip every day, visiting all that’s fun and adventurous in Central Texas. They'll visit lakes, rivers, creeks, and pools – a total of more than 20 different swimming holes and pools, as they swim someplace different every day. Other activities include tubing, stand-up paddleboarding, arcades, trampoline gyms, amusement and water parks, games, exploring, and picnics. When it rains they'll find an indoor adventure.

locations.address: Multiple drop-off locations along MoPac (Central, South, North)

name: Young Chefs Academy® Culinary Camps
description: More than camp, it’s a confidence boost. These hands-on culinary camps help kids build independence, teamwork, and real kitchen skills while cooking from scratch every day. Campers create five to six recipes each week as they learn knife skills, baking, stovetop cooking, food presentation, and collaboration in a fun, supportive environment led by trained instructors.

name: Young Shakespeare 2026
description: is an intensive summer performance group for students aged 13-19, though younger, experienced students have participated in the past. A monthlong rehearsal period culminates in a student-performed, professionally staged and designed production at the Scottish Rite Theater. This is a tuition-based program with reasonable rates, and the program is now in its 18th consecutive year. For audition information, email .

name: Young Women's Leadership Challenge
description: is a yearlong program that empowers high school girls to become confident, capable leaders. It begins with an engaging summer leadership conference where participants build communication skills, self-confidence, critical thinking, and friendships through hands-on activities and meaningful conversations. Throughout the year, students continue learning through mentorship, monthly gatherings, and creating and executing their own community service project.

name: Zach Theater Summer Camps
description: Give your child the gift of creativity, confidence, and fun! Young performers will act, sing, and dance while building lifelong skills and friendships. Enroll today!

name: Camp Bluebonnet
description: A week-long day camp for children with Type 1 diabetes where kids connect with peers facing similar challenges, receive diabetes education, and enjoy recreational activities in a safe, supportive environment. Run by the Children's Diabetes Camp of Central Texas.

name: McBeth Therapeutic Summer Camp
description: Therapeutic summer camp providing individualized support for children with special needs including autism, ADHD, and developmental delays. Small group sizes and trained therapists create a safe, nurturing environment for social skill-building and fun.

name: ASPIRE Summer Program
description: ASPIRE offers structured summer programming for children with autism and related developmental differences. Emphasizes social skills, communication, and community engagement through play-based learning and therapeutic activities.

locations.address: 3755 S Capital of Texas Hwy, Austin 78704

name: Dream a Dream Therapeutic Horsemanship
description: Therapeutic horseback riding camp for children and teens with physical, cognitive, and emotional disabilities. Certified instructors guide riders through equine-assisted activities that improve balance, coordination, confidence, and social skills.

name: Round Rock Adaptive Camp
description: Inclusive adaptive camp run by the City of Round Rock Parks and Recreation. Offers modified activities for youth and young adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities, including arts and crafts, swimming, field trips, and social events.

name: Down Home Ranch Camp
description: Residential camp experience for teens and adults with intellectual and developmental disabilities. Campers enjoy horseback riding, swimming, arts and crafts, music, nature hikes, and farm activities on a working ranch in Elgin, TX.

name: Camp For All
description: Barrier-free camp in Burton, TX serving children and adults with challenging illnesses and special needs. Fully accessible facilities with activities including fishing, swimming, horseback riding, zip lines, and campfire programs.

name: Texas Lions Camp
description: Free residential camp for children with physical disabilities, type 1 diabetes, and cancer. Activities include swimming, horseback riding, fishing, field sports, and campfires. All programs and services are provided at no cost to families.

name: Charis Hills
description: Residential summer camp for children with high-functioning autism, ADHD, learning differences, and social skill challenges. Located on 300 acres with activities including swimming, horseback riding, rock climbing, archery, and social skills groups.
